The linear model has $$3$$ parameters $$	heta$$ $$=$$ $$	exttt{(theta\_0,}$$ $$	exttt{theta\_1,}$$ $$	exttt{theta\_2),}$$ respectively corresponding to an intercept term and calories from $$1$$ and $$2$$ days ago, respectively. Complete the code below:

def $$	exttt{get\_param1(X,}$$ y):
model $$=$$ $$	exttt{LinearRegression(fit\_intercept}$$ $$=$$ (i))
model.fit(X, y)
$$	exttt{theta1\_estimate}$$ $$=$$ $$	exttt{model.coef\_[(ii)]}$$
